_doc: Retro looks for the 3D view (#503), an experiment behind ?look=snes or ?look=ps1 (src/render3d/lookRetro.ts). height: the picture's height in chunky pixels (it's scaled up by a whole number to fill the screen); outline: dark lines where depth jumps (silhouette, how far behind the neighbour must be, as a share of the distance) or bends (crease, on 1/depth), and how dark each makes the pixel, and how far (m) creases are drawn (depth gets too coarse beyond); dither: snes, the ordered (Bayer 4x4) dither's spread in sRGB (0 to 1), ps1, a scale on the PlayStation's own dither table; palette: the colours a pixel may take (snes), or bits per channel (ps1); wobble: snap vertices to a coarse screen grid, this many steps across the screen's height (0 off).
